title: Enoch's ascent and transformation into Metatron

tellings.quote: Enoch himself goes through this amazing personal transformation where he goes up to heaven, he walks with God, and then he turns into Medatron, this angel.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, retells a story from the Book of Enoch, an ancient religious text. In it, Enoch, a man from early scripture, goes up to heaven, walks with God and is changed into Metatron, an angel. Michels brings it up in a wider talk about aliens as an ancient account of a human being transformed by meeting something higher.
